//: This project is NOT hosted on Vercel any more. The live site is the Express
app on our own VPS at https://truekind.truehr.co.in.
The Vercel deployment could only ever serve the static HTML: .vercelignore
excludes server/, so /portal/*, /api/* and /uploads/* have no handler there
and return Vercel's own 404 NOT_FOUND page. That is exactly what the header
Donate button hit — /portal/donate 404'd on true-kind-psi.vercel.app while
working correctly on the real domain.
Patching only /portal would leave the same trap for the content API and the
uploaded media, so the whole host is redirected instead. Anything that still
reaches the old Vercel URL lands on the real site at the matching path.
A temporary redirect (307) on purpose: a permanent one would be cached by
browsers indefinitely, and we would not be able to take the redirect back
if the deployment is ever repurposed.
